title: CourseAsCode Quiz Activity
description: Schema for Quiz_*.yaml Quiz activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be QUIZ

OpeningTime.description: When students can start the quiz (ISO 8601 or dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm)

ClosingTime.description: When the quiz closes (ISO 8601 or dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm)

TimeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds; 0 = no time limit

AttemptsAllowed.description: Alias for AllowedAttempts used in some course files

BuildOnPreviousAttempt.description: Whether a new attempt starts from the previous attempt's answers

GradingMethod.description: How the final grade is calculated across attempts

QuestionBehaviour.description: When and how feedback is shown to students

ShuffleQuestions.description: Randomize order of questions for each attempt

AllowRedosDuringAttempt.description: Allow student to redo questions within an attempt

QuestionIds.description: List of integer question IDs to include in the quiz
